lines: d32: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Stephen Rosales is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d32: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d32: 🕯️ Stephen Rosales is dead — the arena. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d32: What Stephen kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d32: "Stephen's gone." Kennedy looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Stephen." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d32: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Avery blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Fire in Rain (Level 1). Split wood — the inside is dry even when the outside is soaked. Feather sticks catch fast.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Debris Shelter (Level 1). A lean-to of branches and leaves beats nothing. Dead air is insulation.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Reading Tracks (Level 1). Fresh tracks have sharp edges. Old tracks crumble. You can tell how recently something passed.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Star Navigation (Level 1). North Star is constant. Find the Big Dipper, follow the pointer stars. You always know north.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d32: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Wire Snares (Level 1). A loop of wire on a game trail. Simple, effective, ancient. Check at dawn.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Calming Panic (Level 1). Ground them: 5 things you see, 4 you hear, 3 you touch. Breathe with them. Slow is fast.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Small Unit Tactics (Level 1). Flank, don't charge. High ground matters. Never split your group unless you have to.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Improvised Weapons (Level 1). Everything is a weapon if you're desperate. A rock, a stick, a handful of dirt in the eyes.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Managing Fear (Level 1). Fear is data, not orders. Acknowledge it, then decide anyway. Courage is fear that kept going.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Tracking People (Level 1). People leave sign: broken twigs, footprints, disturbed earth. You can follow.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Night Hunting (Level 1). Hunting at night is not hunting blind. It is hunting by ear, by smell, by patience.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Shield Wall (Level 1). Shoulder to shoulder in the wilds, you brace as one. While an ally fights beside you, blows that reach you land softer — the line holds together or not at all.
d32: 📖 LEARNED: Tripwire (Level 1). You string a wire at ankle height. The next monster that moves eats dirt — prone, stunned, and embarrassed. (Sets up the party.)
d32: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d32: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Stephen Rosales, 32 days. The mantle passes to Avery He.
d32: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Avery He, 26 — an infantry soldier. Their hands know different work now: Iron Stomach, Berserker Rage, Echo Location.
d32: The village's quarrel was with Stephen — and Stephen is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d32: At the grave, Lamar, Kennedy, Hryhoriy and 4 more speak for Avery — "Stephen trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d32: The fire knew Avery before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
